description: This Java class defines a fragment for the Android app's settings, specifically for additional language options. It loads preferences from a resource, handles preference click events, and sets the activity title.

classes.name: AdditionalLanguageSettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment for managing additional language settings in the app.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from the specified XML resource.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the preference click listener after the view is created.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the activity title when the fragment starts.

methods.name: onPreferenceClick
methods.description: Handles click events on preferences, navigating to the language tweaks fragment if the specific preference is clicked.
